notes.title: Shrine's Legacy Has a Release Date!
notes.content:
[h2]The Legacy Will Be Known[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello everyone, it's finally time...to lock down a release date![/p][p][/p][p][b]Shrine's Legacy[/b] will be launching on [b]October 7, 2025![/b][/p][previewyoutube="1BawF3PIQwM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]🔥🧊⚡💧 Cast Spells, Fight Enemies and Solve Puzzles in Action Combat[/h3][p]Use your [b]weapon[/b] and [b]magic spells[/b] to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, explore, and interact with the environment! Run on water, Make bridges out of wind, and more! Bring fear upon Aklor's hordes with your prowess![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/90fc1e9f0fbfcac4c332d057763b4dc3fa9f29dc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Two-player Co-op Mode[/h3][p]You can play in [b]single player[/b] or in [b]two player couch co-op[/b] modes. You can switch player 2 in or out at any time. If you have a good internet connection, you can also play online through [b]Steam Remote Play[/b] or [b]Parsec[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c8dc0e209b4ae066eddd5204013e78ae258854f5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Take a Journey Back to the Past[/h3][p][/p][p]Experience a story themed by loss and how people deal with it, with heavy influence from classics of the Super Nintendo era! Fight an evil villain and his lackeys, befriend a talking postcat, spar with sentient dummies, wrestle with macho luchadors and more in this adventure![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/a711090618b887a4f342416840c24148f3449cfb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Keep Up with Our Progress 😎[/h3][p]Here's some of our links:[/p][p]Discord: [url="https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD"]https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD[/url][/p][p]Twitter: [dynamiclink href="https://twitter.com/shrineslegacy"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist / Follow [/b]to be notified on launch, or check out the[b] Demo:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435410/Shrines_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Closing[/h2][p][/p][p]This game has been a long, long time in the making and it's really exciting to finally be close enough to the finish line that we know the date! To everyone who's been around since the Kickstarter (or even earlier!) thank you so much for sticking with us for these years. 💖[/p][p]
There's just a little bit further to go...we hope you all can stick around till the end!
[/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p]Joe[/p]

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #39: Upcoming Events / Announcements
notes.content: [p]Behind the scenes, we are working hard to get the game as finished and polished as possible. But I wanted to focus this update on some upcoming events, [b]including an announcement (of an announcement)?![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Gamescom and PAXWest[/h3][p][/p][p]Our publisher will be taking our game to [b]Gamescom[/b] [b](August 20-24)[/b] and [b]PaxWest[/b] [b](August 29-September 1)[/b]. If you happen to be present at either of these 2 events be sure to say hi to the publisher at the booth, maybe even take a picture, we'd love to see it! As much as we'd love to be able to go to an event in-person again, for now the focus is solely on finishing the game in the best state possible.[/p][p][/p][p]As an aside, we were also recently a part of the [b]Debut Festival[/b], a new steam event made to appreciate developers who are making or who have finished their first commercial project! We even got a cool little badge to show off on our Steam page for it![/p][p][/p][p][b]Lastly worth mentioning: On August 20th during Gamescom, we'll be releasing a very important announcement about the game. 😉[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Mapping Progress[/h3][p][/p][p]Beyond that, progress is constantly being made on the game itself! As just one example,[b] a number of maps have been improved and polished[/b], although a handful are still needing that final polish level. [b]Here's a few examples[/b] of recent map glow-ups courtesy of our main mapper![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/678deb2c5f6f081bdceb784963ab9eba2e42920b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/108ff18671c10d683f6973931436ffa5e6072731.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/fcb976802501f40479c4105347c787351bd36715.png"][/img][/p][h3]Closing[/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, and the finish line gets ever closer. Please look forward to the upcoming announcement![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p]Joe[/p]

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #38: Content Complete!
notes.content:
[h3]Nextfest and Other Events![/h3][p]
Firstly, letting you all know that Shrine's Legacy will be part of the indie.io (our publisher) booth at [b]Gamescom[/b] in Germany on August 20th to 24th! We won't be personally present, but if you are there feel free to check out the booth and show your support. :)[/p][p][/p][p]Also, we've had an amazing last month for events in general! We participated in the June [b]Steam Nextfest[/b], which was active until June 16th (big thanks to everyone who checked out the demo during that time!), and were also being shown by a friend at a convention in Canada called [b]Game Con Canada[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]We most recently also participated in the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QAanpHTfrAw"]Indie Quest 2025 Showcase[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hyRhu8kWv2E"]The MIX Summer Showcase[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Check out our [b]updated trailer[/b] AND our [b]new trailer[/b] on YouTube:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Updated Trailer:
[/b][/p][previewyoutube="BNY60dWDWkU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]New Trailer:[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DY-IaYs14Js;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We've had some great results from these events and our wishlists are currently looking pretty promising![/p][p][/p][h3]Content Complete[/h3][p][/p][p][b]The game is now tested and fully playable with the entire story now integrated front to back.[/b] But there are still some optional scenes, a handful of puzzles, and more detailed collisions missing or buggy for many rooms. And other random things like steam achievements still must be done.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cutscene Progress[/h3][p][/p][p]All main story cutscenes are now complete! Some of them, especially in the late game, still need a healthy layer of polishing wax, however. I've been finding it hard to choose cutscenes to show that won't be spoilery, so please forgive me. Instead, [b]please check out the new trailers above and await the upcoming release date announcement trailer for more spicy stuff[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]Map Progress[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New maps were made![/b] Now all the maps are on a first draft at minimum, though many will be returned to for some final polish. 💪[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/80bf2b35af16920e11994094d50a7349559d00ff.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4a3e4b0850235f006620cedd13284a7059c603b7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/104547461b0f621d6de5c61bd930782038df6330.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Closing[/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading another Steam Chronicle![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p]Joe[/p]

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #37: Cutscene and Balancing Progress
notes.content:
Greetings and happy May! This will be a short update as we're busy grinding toward Content Complete for this month!

[h1]Cutscene Progress[/h1]

We're on the final cutscenes. We've officially made it up to the inner part of the final dungeon, with final scenes and a handful of optional quest cutscenes remaining.

[h1]Enemy Balance and Other[/h1]

Enemy balance first draft is now complete for most of the game, every enemy has now had base stats set, and only the last few dungeons and optional areas still remain to be tested.

Additionally, a bit more pixel art has been completed, and mapping has been done, although there is still just a bit more to do for both of these.

[i]Pictured below: These guys don't mess around![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/469549a0bc44029cc01a187f8d4156fc8face7d1.gif[/img]

[i]Pictured below: Rio and Reima patiently awaiting the game to be finished![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/44966c93c9c3921b73c49b2bfe7701eec8e4c826.gif[/img]

[h1]Closing[/h1]

Hope you all have a happy May! We will keep pushing towards the finish line the best that we can. Stay tuned for more info as we accelerate into the final phase of development before SL is launched!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #36: More Mapping and Cutscene Work
notes.content:
As we enter a new month and we get closer to Beta it's time for another Shrine's Chronicle!

[h1]Mapping and Enemies Placed[/h1]

Many more maps are complete, with almost all maps for the game being at a base level in appearance now. Some collision work still needs done but some progress was made for that too. The main exception to appearance being complete is the optional dungeon which still needs to have the rooms tiled. 

Additionally, all the enemy placements are now done for almost all of the maps!

Let's take a look at a couple new treasure spots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/147c451b229b3f9ac61f763cd61930cb6facb7b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/83fcd55f1c17084b4b0191390f3e30117e2dae31.png[/img]

[h1]Cutscene Progress[/h1]

Every remaining cutscene in the game is now planned out in the code but a number still need to be scripted. However, they are closer to complete now than ever! We should be pretty close to having the cutscenes finished by the next Steam Chronicle.

[h1]Closing[/h1]

Thanks for joining us for another Steam Chronicle!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.content:
Happy March and welcome to the 35th Steam Chronicle!

More [b]cutscene work, maps, and pixel art[/b] have been completed!

[h1]Mapping Progress[/h1]

We're getting started on finishing up the mapping for the remaining towns now (such as Omdale, seen below), along with Pyragord Mountain. Here's a couple newly mapped screenshots our main mapper Decky lined up for us to share in the update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d93a9c8a683c35c90e5a738116b8c17d2fb37559.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/6234c71516f06ffa3d92ef939dba040ec7636107.png[/img]

[h1]Pixel Art[/h1]

Pixel art as mentioned before is nearing completion! There's only straggling pieces of art left that we come up with while polishing and finishing cutscenes that aren't finished now.

Here's a glow-up for our save point, including one for where quick travel is available. The artist really went above and beyond with this one, and I think it turned out amazing! :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/70604c48d37b32e168b56db3431c6942535ff179.gif[/img]

Trying to avoid very spoilery stuff is challenging since we are getting deeper into the story with the most recent scenes. I will share a proper cutscene in the next update, but for now, here is our new improved effect for water rising and lowering in Veyrlorn Palace:

[previewyoutube=XntzfrzyOFo;full][/previewyoutube]

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #32: Boss AI Done + Feature Complete
notes.content:
Some big news this update: the Boss AI is completed! We are now also officially in the "Feature Complete" stage. There's still a ton of work to do on content, but it's still a huge milestone for us.

[h1]Boss AI Complete[/h1]

As mentioned above, the AI for all bosses is now complete! I wanted to show off at least one so here is one of the early game bosses after the end of the demo (note that some things like sound effects are still not implemented, and boss behavior is subject to change / polish):

[previewyoutube=L2T-D2d_GMI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Dungeon and Map Progress[/h1]

There's been some mapping progress on the Marsh dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/18401d5a3008ce28f203b1ecca62b662b58280ef.png[/img]

And additionally, many new rooms in the overworld are now mapped!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d270d3a7e90de2e68a10488fb83e60d7f200eeb7.png[/img]

[h1]Pixel Art Progress[/h1]

More pixel art has also been completed! Here is a small sample preview of the many new jewel, potion, and item icons that have been made:


[h1]Cutscene Progress[/h1]

Alan is done going through the cutscenes and adding portrait expressions! Additionally, a good chunk of new in-game cutscenes have been scripted.

The next couple months will be mostly dedicated towards scripting cutscenes in-game. Expect a non-spoilery cutscene preview or 2 in the next couple updates! 🙂

[h1]Closing[/h1]

Completing the Boss AI is a big milestone for me personally. It's been really cool seeing them all come to life, and I can't wait to see people take them on once the game has been released! Thanks as always for reading, and...

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #31: Lotsa Random Stuff!
notes.content:
[h1]Updated GameMaker + Bugfixes[/h1]

I did something I've been putting off for a while and updated our game development IDE to the newest version. This brought some new bugs with it I needed to fix which took some time. But I also took it as an opportunity to fix a lot of long-time bugs I never got around to dealing with. There's still a handful I haven't had time to get to, but it will really help out later having a big chunk of them out of the way.

[h1]Cutscene Progress[/h1]

Alan is almost done going through the entire script of the game and adding character expressions to the portraits throughout! He's reached chapter 20 out of 21, so there's only 2 remaining now!

[h1]Dungeon and Map Progress[/h1]

Postcat Jeff minigame is now mostly functional! Some aspects are still incomplete but this video should give you a pretty good idea of how it will work. You control Jeff the Postcat as he moves on a grid like old-school maze type games. You try to avoid the obstacles and get to the end, maybe collecting some things along the way to open up the path!

[previewyoutube=Y6GqL1I1HgU;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also gotten started planning out the mapping for another dungeon, the Hendran Marsh! There's nothing new to show yet, but there most likely will be next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c6ee93bebf6fc699eca8ac990aa3bab966ec14d6.png[/img]

[h1]NPC Pixel Art Progress[/h1]

We're almost done with NPC's! We have one more batch in the making right now, and then there will only be a few misc NPC's and extra pieces of art for them needed.

Here's a small sample of the last batch of NPCs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d3126fe486effd3d2d386f21175ed5c018bdc816.gif[/img]

[h1]Closing[/h1]

That concludes yet another update! With some of this other work out of the way, next time around expect all the remaining boss AI to be completed. 💪

Until next time,

Joe

With spooky season coming, it only makes sense to show off some of the major updates to a spooky dungeon called Moglore Woods. Here's a shot of the woods in action:

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #27: Music, Sound, NPCs, and Dungeons
notes.content:
Happy July and I hope everyone had a good weekend!

First I wanted to share some exciting news. We had the opportunity to be briefly showcased on [b]IGN Live[/b], where we shared some footage of a [b]new gameplay trailer[/b]! If you haven't seen the new trailer yet, I definitely recommend checking it out, as it has some new footage that hasn't been seen before. I’m planning to add it to Steam here shortly as well!

[previewyoutube=zLZPkUI9zmk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Dungeon Progress[/h1]

[b]Mapping for the final dungeon is now complete! [/b]Part of me is sad we won't be showing it off, because in my opinion it's turned out really great. But I think it's going to be an awesome surprise for you when you play the finished game. 😉

There's also been a lot of progress in the maps for[b] Veyrlorn Palace[/b]. It is now complete minus a bit of fixes and polish, and a few story-oriented rooms we're saving for a bit later.

[previewyoutube=qgrmDB05b-Y;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to progress on previous dungeons, [b]mapping for 2 more dungeons has begun[/b]. One of them is a [b]secret optional dungeon[/b]. The other one is the [b]Crystal Cavern[/b], which was very briefly shown in our newest trailer recently. Here's a screenshot of how the aesthetic is coming along!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d12cf190cb103fffe1c26ce239fe02f661c2ef3f.png[/img]
[h1]Music[/h1]

More music tracks have been written. You can hear one in the Veyrlorn Palace video above. 🙂

[h1]NPC Placeholders and Dialogue Implemented[/h1]

Previously we had most of the NPC dialogue written. [b]Now it is implemented in all the towns using placeholder NPCs![/b]

[h1]Boss Art[/h1]

The two bosses pixel arts that were in progress have been completed, and the [b]final remaining boss pixel arts are now in the process of being created[/b] (and pretty deep in the progress to getting finished)! 

After we finish the boss art, we'll be getting started on new [b]NPC art[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/59ac08188fc871d7526df1d596d8dccdcaae7864.png[/img]

Joseph

notes.title: Shrine’s Legacy Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that [b]Shrine’s Legacy is now being published by Freedom Games[/b] ([url=https://freedom.gg]https://freedom.gg[/url]). We didn't make this decision lightly. As a few of you may know, Alan and I have been vocal about our goals of staying as independent as possible while developing Shrine's Legacy. And that hasn't changed; with Freedom Games, true to their name, we maintain complete creative and development freedom. Freedom will be helping us by taking care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing Shrine's Legacy. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. And in return, we can spend more time actually building an awesome game for you all to enjoy.

You may also be concerned about horror stories of publishers ruining the vision of a game or forcing arbitrary restrictions on the dev team. Know that we were very careful when considering whether to go with a publisher or not, and selected Freedom because they are committed to our vision of the game and making the game and its launch the best it can be.

With the big announcement done, it's time to get into the dev progress updates! That’s right, we’ve decided to start updating Steam with a devlog each month, which will share a bit of the progress and behind-the-scenes of working on the game as we go along.

[h3]Story Cutscene Progress[/h3]
As of writing this, I've managed to build basic scenes in the game up to when you obtain the 6th gemstone. So, good progress has been made! With some diligence, the full game worth of scenes should be finished by next month's Steam Chronicle! 💪 It'll be immensely satisfying to have the full story text play out in the game, even if it is in a simple state.

[h3]Siltens[/h3]
Here's a work-in-progress of a new area! It's called Siltens, and it's a town located in a large canyon. The views are spectacular and so it's rather effective at pulling in tourists. Since it's still a WIP expect some adjustments and changes for the final game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/0632c2d76a09e80391428c8df7f505e7ede33b75.png[/img]

We can’t wait for you all to get to see and play more of the game. Thank you for all of the support you've given us. If you want to keep up with our development progress a bit closer, make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ShrinesLegacy]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=http://discord.gg/KxnRukD]Discord[/url]. While you’re here on Steam, make sure to wishlist the game as well!

notes.title: Official Steam Demo release and Demo v1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.6 is now out[/h1]

In addition, you can now play the demo on Steam without joining the mailing list now! Just download the demo from the official Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435410/Shrines_Legacy/]Shrine's Legacy on Steam[/url]

[h2]Important Notes for those who have played the Mailing List Demo:[/h2]

Unfortunately, owning the mailing list demo may cause issues with downloading the new demo. Because of this, we will be disabling the Steam keys for the Mailing list version of the demo shortly, but the DRM-free version from our mailing list should continue to work if you wish to keep playing the older version in the future. Once we disable the Mailing List demo keys, you should no longer have any issues downloading the new version of the demo directly from Steam via the above link.

Additionally, if you played the demo via our mailing list before this, please note that the new version of the demo uses a new folder for storing config and save files, which means by default your save data and config settings will be gone when you start up the game again.

However, It is possible to copy the contents from the old folder to the new folder and they should work. Both folders should be in appdata for most windows machines. The old folder is called "Project_Shrine" and the new folder is called "Shrines_Legacy". 

If you copy the files over you should be able to continue where you left off. The new save files will not be backwards compatible though due to changes in how Game Maker handles save files in its newest version, so keep this in mind.

[h2]Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.6 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Major Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated Shrine's Legacy to the newest version of GameMaker Studio 2.
[*]It's now possible to switch characters and play co-op as soon as Reima joins the party.
[*]Uses a new folder to save and load config and save file data from.
[*]Somewhat major co-op changes, listed next.
[/list]
[h3]Co-op Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]When Player 2 triggers a cutscene by walking into a trigger, they will now be in control of that conversation (before, it was always P1).
[*]When the party changes, players will get to keep control of their respective characters they had BEFORE the party change.
[*]It's now possible for P2 to control P1 if there's currently no second character. You can switch between the two players at any time by pressing any major button or start button on the respective player's controller or keyboard.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Using a HP or MP increasing potion on a character that's not in the party no longer causes a potion to fly across space and time.
[*]Footstep sounds now properly play when important characters in scenes are running.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could potentially cause issues in a couple of different scenes in co-op mode when P1 was down at the end of a battle event.
[*]Fixed a mistake in the intro where the sprite of the character didn't quite match up when their eyes blink.
[*]Fixed a oversight where the game could think that a character is outside of a building when they are really inside the building.
[*]Fixed an exploit where Reima could get free EXP every time the player saves/loads at a specific moment in the game.
[*]Fixed a crash that could happen when loading the game with a specific jewel equipped to a specific character.
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed links to website and other places now that this is an official release of the demo. Also adjusted post-credits text a bit.
[*]Made an adjustment to a room in the first dungeon to make the way to progress easier to understand.
[*]Updated the art on the Postcat Office.
[/list]



Oh... also, we never actually posted patch notes for the v1.5 of the demo (and there were a lot!), so I'll include those here too:

[h2]Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.5 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Major Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]World Map added! You now get a map at the beginning of the game and can see the layout of the world of Ardemia!
[*]Many adjustments to combat and enemies to make both hitting and getting hit feel more impactful.
[*]We have a new Logo for the game now! It's implemented both on the Title Screen and in-game.
[*]A special surprise if you find and talk to the goats in the pen at the beginning.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Slight rebalancing of most enemies and bosses.
[*]Knockback has been increased all around the board, both for players and enemies. Many enemies have had their hp has been slightly decreased to account for this.
[*]Enemies have slightly more damage on average.
[*]Dash attacks have slightly increased i-frames. You'll still take damage if dash attacking recklessly though.
[*]There is now hitstun when getting hit/ hitting enemies.
[*]When taking damage, you can't act instantly like before: there is now a short stun period where you can't do anything.
[*]Critical hits (i.e. exploiting weaknesses) now have new cool effects to show that you're dealing extra damage.
[*]You can now speak to npcs and examine objects from further away.
[*]Opening a treasure with a jewel in it now gives you a description of what that jewel does.
[*]Changed the wording and order of the options when speaking to Delane in Marize to make more sense and be clearer.
[*]The dummy juice is now slightly more effective. ;)
[*]If you are dashing but not holding the dash button, you'll now do a normal attack instead of a dash attack when attacking.
[*]Adjusted credits at end to be up-to-date.
[*]Lodestone jewel now pulls in pickups with less delay.
[*]Lots of small cutscene adjustments.
[/list]
[h3]Aesthetics:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Getting hit has much more effects now. Hitstun added, which makes it look more impactful when damage is dealt or taken. Players now flash red when hit as well.
[*]Adjusted the minions in the opening with the cloaked figure and added a new big minion.
[*]Player UI, boss health bars, enemy healthbars, revivebars and more have all been greatly improved visually.
[*]There are visual effects for stepping in certain terrain now, such as leaves in the grass, and footsteps in the sand on the beach.
[*]Wind-blown leaves now flow in the forest.
[*]Adjusted the shadow of the Froogah enemy and the hitbox of the friendly Froogah NPC.
[*]Adjusted Aklor's shadow positioning.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where your animation would reset every time you turned while dashing.
[*]Fixed an input bug where letting go of a button for exactly one frame, then repressing it would still count as you not pressing the button.
[*]If you are controlling Reima during the beginning of the mask fight, you will now automatically switch to Rio at the start of the fight.
[*]Fixed a small camera bug at the beginning of the final scene of the demo.
[*]The light orbs the mask boss could shoot had health and could be hit, but wouldn't be destroyed even at 0 hp. Now they are destroyed at 0 hp.
[*]You can no longer faintly see the cloud fog over the credits screen now.
[*]Fixed a bug where the light orbs surrounding the trap monsters could survive when finishing off the trap with an ice spell.
[*]Fixed a bug that would show text when rapidly exitting or entering Carolyn's basement via the door after speaking with the save point outside.
[*]Fixed a bug where Reima sometimes wouldn't move to the doorway properly for the scene when first entering Carolyn's house.
[*]Normally when attacking the slime boss, it will create it's next set of slimes quicker for each hit you land. This wasn't working for the second phase of the battle, but has now been fixed.
[*]Fixed three uncommon bugs related to 2 player mode and roofs appearing/disappearing at the wrong time in Marize.
[/list]

If you decide to play for the first time, hope you you enjoy the demo! And if you a returning player, we hope you enjoy the updates!

We also have a public Discord where we love to hear player feedback and ideas or even just chat! Check it out if you are interested: [url=https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD]https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD[/url]

At any rate, that's all for now,

Until next time!

notes.title: Shrine's Legacy Demo V1.4b
notes.content:
This update adds features which will be helpful for our upcoming speedrun contest (stay tuned for more info on that!), along with some bonus features including a buff to Reima's attack range and MP gained when attacking enemies!

-Full Patch Notes:
[olist]
[*]Reima buffs!
-Range on normal attack is moderately larger.
-Gains more MP when hitting enemies than Rio. Used to gain 1.25x MP compared to Rio, now gains 1.5x compared to Rio. This equates to her regaining 1 MP per every 2 attacks, compared to Rio's 1 MP per every 3 attacks.
[*]Speedrun friendly stuff:
-Can now mash by alternating with action, cancel, or dash to mash through dialog quicker and more comfortably.
-Text now moves much faster than before when mashing through dialog.
-There is now a speedrun timer which can be toggled on and off. (Shortcut F1)
-Copy File is now an option on the file select. Use this to make backup points wherever you'd like to play or practice again!
[*]Config updates:
-"Visuals" and "Sound" now have their own menu in the config instead being collectively known as "Other".
-Speedrun timer option added to config.
-UI font can be set between Retro and Modern, where modern is a smaller font.
-Music can be set between Retro and Modern (it's another way to switch between chiptune and orchestral music which already existed). (Shortcut F5)
[*]Tweaks/Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug where the game might pause for a split second when casting spells on enemies.
-Fixed the hitboxes for the trees on Groonis Island, so that they get in the way less often.
-Fixed a bug where certain jewel descriptions would go slightly out of the box when viewing jewels in the status menu.
-Adjusted the selection box when choosing an option in a dialog box so that it's properly centered.
-If you lose in a boss fight and retry, the in-game timer will keep ticking from where you left off, instead of reverting back to the old time. This also applies for when you quit the game normally. Whatever your current in-game time is when you quit is what time will be saved on your file. 
[/olist]

Thank you, and as always, feedback is welcomed!

notes.title: Shrine's Legacy Demo V1.3
notes.content:
With this patch, we're adding something highly requested; a fully featured lunging dash attack! A lot of work has been put into this new dash attack, so we hope you will have fun with it! It's going to have a large effect on how the whole game plays, both now and in the future. This patch also includes some bug fixes and small controls improvements.

-Full Patch Notes:
[olist]
[*] Dash attacks added for both Rio and Reima! Attack while running to perform a dash attack!
-Earthroot jewel (reduced knockback) replaced with a jewel that improves your dash attack.
-Some minor buffs to certain boss HP's to account for the new dash attack.
[*] Ally AI was adjusted to handle when the player dash attacks, and should be better at avoiding damage now.
[*] Repeated attacks can be buffered into other directions more easily now.
[*] It's now possible to turn during the startup of an attack, making it slightly easier to face the correct way when attacking.
[*] Adjusted the timing for Rio and Reima's sound effects when attacking to be sooner during the attack.
[*] Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a crash that could sometimes happen when you are attacked by an enemy.
-The thunder sound on the title crawl no longer ignores your sound volume setting.
-Fixed a bug where the light orb enemies on Groonis Island would no longer damage you after being destroyed once.
-Fixed a bug where the game could track a character's HP when they aren't in the party and trigger near fatal effects such as the near fatal sound when it shouldn't.
[/olist]
